description: Open CASCADE's own STEP of blend/nurbs-cap-cylinder-rim-fillet (a cylinder capped by a NURBS sphere, its rim filleted at r 0.5), read as a part: its blend is a B-spline surface walked round the rim. Arris's reader had not finished it after 11 minutes in the test profile (plans/nurbs-face-blend step 5b, found by the read-back stage). The desired assertion: it reads, quickly, and matches Open CASCADE's reading.
